caption: This drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with ornate detailing, shown against a plain, beige background. The chest features a rectangular structure with a flat top and stands on four straight legs. The upper section has three doors, with the central door adorned with an intricate circular geometric pattern and flanked by vertical black finial-like elements, while the two side doors each display carved foliage designs. The lower section of the chest contains two wide drawers, each with decorative horizontal inlaid patterns and black handles. Vertical black spindle-shaped accents separate sections of the chest. The overall color palette is primarily natural wood tones with black detailing, and the drawing is centered on the page with ample blank space surrounding the furniture.
title: Two Drawer Sunflower Chest - front view
